decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered 
Application Form, L0-01-0, EX-01-0, EX-02-0, EX-03-0, EX-04-0, EX-05-0, EX-06-0, EX-07-0, EX-08-0(terrace), EX-08-0(roof), EX-09-0, EX-10-0, EX-11-0, EX-12-0, PR-01-0, PR-03-0, PR-04-0, PR-05-0, PR-06-0, PR-07-0, PR-09-0, PR-12-0, PR-14-0, PR-16-0, PR-17-0, Received 2 January 2013 
PR-02-1, PR-08-1, PR-10-1, PR-11-1, PR-13-1, Received 6 February 2013 
Email from K Matthys, Samples, Received18 February 2013
therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The timber used in construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby approved shall match the samples submitted and approved as 'Western Red Cedar', stained 'Jacobean Walnut', or as otherwise approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works on the site.
Condition : 4 - The glazing for the proposed balcony and balustrade shall be obscure glazed within the side elevation adjacent to 44E Sutton Court Road.

Condition : 5 - The glazing within the northern half of the rear elevation of the dormer shall be obscure glazed, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscure glazing. The timber screen shall remain in place for the lifetime of the development.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension, installation of 8 new windows to the side elevation and erection of a external staircase to the rear of the property leading to the garden
